signedWireReconciliation.evidence: Executed worker assertions compare the retained signed frame with the confirmed ledger frame and bind signature, slot, ring and full note commitment. Raw signed wire and encrypted recovery jobs are omitted.

receiptVersionPreservation.evidence: The passing journey compares the complete records.read receipt object before and after retry and completed re-entry. The worker also asserts the confirmation receipt protocolVersion. Numeric storage-version values were not separately emitted.

measurements.scope: this harness, its registered service/command groups, and observed descendants; excludes unrelated Go/build lanes
measurements.method: Linux /proc VmRSS and process-lifetime VmHWM, sampled while each owned process exists
limitations: Concurrent RSS is a sampled sum, not a kernel-reported instantaneous process-tree peak.
VmHWM is the OS high-water mark through the last observation; short-lived processes or later peaks may be missed.
Shared resident pages may be counted in more than one process. Kernel memory and filesystem cache are excluded.
These are measurements of this disposable local run, not production performance claims.

redaction: No signing key material, keypair files, private witness values, raw signed frames, encrypted job contents, prompt/lesson text, operation IDs, service arguments or raw private logs are included. Synthetic public addresses, transaction signatures, commitment/account-data hashes and scalar test results are retained.
